description: Update a data export: rename, change datasets or frequency, pause (`isEnabled: false`) or resume, move it to another bucket/prefix, or rotate credentials (send `accessKeyId` and `secretAccessKey` together). Location and credential changes are verified with a test file first. Newly added event datasets start from now.

bucket.description: Bucket name only, not a URL.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

datasets.description: What to export. email_events: sends, deliveries, bounces, complaints, opens, clicks, unsubscribes. sms_events: SMS lifecycle. custom_events: events tracked via API/SDK/integrations. subscribers: a daily snapshot of every subscriber. Default: email_events, custom_events, subscribers.

endpoint.description: Optional HTTPS origin of an S3-compatible service (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze). Leave empty for AWS and GCS.

frequency.description: How often new data is written. Default: every_15_minutes.

isEnabled.description: false pauses the export; true resumes it.

pathPrefix.description: Folder inside the bucket. Files land under <pathPrefix>/<dataset>/date=YYYY-MM-DD/.

region.description: Bucket region in lowercase, for example us-east-1. Required for Amazon S3; optional for GCS, where it defaults to auto.

name: update_data_export

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_data_export` MCP tool.

dataExport.description: The data export record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
